stories.summary: Operate every builder control from the keyboard on every surface
Show a visible focus indicator on every focused control on every surface
Expose the name, role and state of every custom status component
Expose every form field's label, instructions and error to assistive technology
Announce run progress and readiness changes to assistive technology
Convey readiness, verdict and diff status without relying on colour
Meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast for text and status colours in normal, hover and focus states
Run automated accessibility checks on every builder change in continuous verification
Reflow every builder surface to 320 CSS pixels without two-dimensional scrolling
